title: Python 3.15.2, 3.14.10, 3.13.18, 3.12.16 and 3.11.18 are out

blocks.text: Here are expedited security releases of Python 3.15, 3.14, 3.13, 3.12 and 3.11.

They address the compromised eMudhra intermediate CA keys. These keys are now blocked by the ssl module as a last resort against their use. Normal uses of pip, including to upgrade pip itself, are now safe from attacks based on those compromised keys, even if pip hasn’t been updated yet.
Python 3.15.2 and 3.14.10 come with binary installers. Python 3.13.18, 3.12.16 and 3.11.18 are source-only security releases.
These fixes were already included in Python 3.15.1 and 3.14.9.
This fix was already included in Python 3.15.0 and 3.14.9.
For the full details, see the 3.15.2 changelog, 3.14.10 changelog, 3.13.18 changelog, 3.12.16 changelog and 3.11.18 changelog.
As always, upgrading is highly recommended to all users of affected versions.

Thanks to all of the many volunteers who help make Python development and these releases possible! Please consider supporting our efforts by volunteering yourself or through organisation contributions to the Python Software Foundation.
Your certified release team, Hugo van Kemenade Thomas Wouters Pablo Galindo Salgado Ned Deily Steve Dower
